scope: Logical frontend payload materialization and hot-owner maturity-egress contract only. No payload storage implementation, SRAM macro, physical port count, HBM mapping, controller, cycle/timing/throughput, PPA, model/GPU, or new A4 DSE claim.

forbidden_interpretations: frontend payload materialization is an HBM transaction
logical fragment count selects a storage port count or latency
logical payload envelope selects an SRAM macro

transactions.ordering: exactly eight fragments per record, indices 0..7 in order, last only at index 7
transactions.completion_effect: hot payload becomes materialized for the exact opaque payload_ref; no maturity or publication event is emitted

transactions.ordering: legal only after the matching immutable RETAIN maturity disposition and only once for that retained record
transactions.completion_effect: requests a transient, non-authoritative copy for later P3 staging

transactions.ordering: exactly eight fragments per accepted read request, indices 0..7 in order, last only at index 7
transactions.completion_effect: the ingress adapter may subsequently form P3 fragment/sidecar transactions; this response alone cannot claim, write, publish, or release a page

environment_assumptions: for each accepted kv_arrival, the frontend materializer presents one matching complete eight-fragment payload transaction before it presents the matching immutable maturity disposition
the frontend does not reuse a payload_ref for a different live entry identity
while valid is asserted and ready is low, every transaction payload field remains stable
dut_guarantees_for_later_behavior: the hot owner accepts a fragment only for its matching live hot entry and rejects stale, duplicate, out-of-order, or mismatched-payload_ref fragments
an incomplete or faulted materialization cannot satisfy a hot maturity egress request
a hot maturity egress response is an exact copy associated with one accepted retained request and never changes authoritative residency
DROP cannot create an admission egress request and no payload materialization event changes mask or admission disposition

required_follow_on.requires: A later functional-hot-storage wrapper may use simulation/reference backing only until the separately planned memory-realization gate. It must implement these transactions without representing its backing as a selected SRAM realization.
required_follow_on.not_authorized: No Chisel payload store, P3 staging write, R2 candidate, R1 request, page allocation, metadata publish, or source packet behavior is enabled by this interface closure.
